## Appearance

A tall and remarkably handsome youth, he possesses an attractive overall appearance. He has wavy chestnut hair, hazel or mischievous light-brown eyes, and a mouth often twisted into a mocking grin.

## Personality

Hugh Carrow is a tall, mischievous youth with light-brown eyes and a mocking grin who is known for teasing every girl. Intelligent and holding distinct personal perspectives, he is determined to enjoy life fully while contributing his best to it, and he plans to independently cover his own college expenses.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## History

Hugh Carrow spent three years in Alberta after his father fell ill. He also spent a summer visiting his cousins in [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick) before returning home. Upon attending [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school, Hugh teased [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) by calling her 'Carrots' and pulling her hair, causing an enraged [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to smash her slate over his head. Hugh later engaged in an intense academic rivalry with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and silently competed with her in class while ignoring her. When [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) was stranded on a bridge pile after her boat sank, Hugh rescued her in his dory and offered her his friendship, though she stubbornly refused him. Later, both Hugh and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) attended Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy) together, where Hugh ultimately won the Medal while [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) won the [Avery](../codex/places.md#avery) scholarship. Upon graduating, Hugh selflessly withdrew his application for the teaching position at the [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school so that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) could take it instead to support her home. When [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) met him on the hill and thanked him for stepping aside, the former foes reconciled and became friends.

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/hugh-carrow--nell-harcourt.md)

Hugh and [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) share a complex dynamic as classmates and academic rivals. Their relationship began with friction when Hugh teased her about her hair and pulled it, prompting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to smash her slate over his head and stubbornly refuse to speak to or forgive him. Despite this initial hostility, Hugh harbored an infatuation for [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), keeping a dropped rose of hers, silently competing with her in class, and ultimately rescuing her in a dory when her boat sank during a play, though she initially refused his offer of friendship.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P51](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0051), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P93](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0093), +16 more_
